msg: When you are playing, dont just alternate from left to right when choosing the gnomes meaning choose the same one multiple times in a row, especially when it is giving you a high number of mushrooms. When you get 5x, each round will either be the left or right gnome that pays out the best on all 5x turns. try to find which one that is as early in the round as you can. if a gnome give you a "0" stop using that Gnome (Left or Right) for several turns as it will continue to give you either "0" or "1". I hope this helps, find patterns early and realize the pattern will be different each round. I found in my game that if the left gnome was paying high for the 5x round, the next round the right gnome would be paying higher mushrooms the following round. but they are asking me to give you advice, so beware that they may switch it up. I hope you find this useful and Good luck Gnomie lol.
